en.headline: A little clarity before you commit.
en.intro: Keep the exact date, total cost and cancellation terms together. This is your planning checklist—not a reservation or a refund guarantee.
en.base: Quoted total for your whole party
en.extras: Additional fees for your whole party
en.empty: Enter both amounts; use 0 if no extra fees apply.
en.estimate: Your inputs only. No live price or currency conversion. Confirm all taxes and mandatory charges with the seller.
en.deadline: Cancellation deadline and timezone (copy the seller’s wording)
en.refund: Refund method and timing (copy the seller’s wording)
checks: Exact date, time, timezone and ticket variant checked
Traveler count, age rules and language checked
Total price, inclusions and extra fees checked
Cancellation deadline, fees and refund method checked
Confirmation, voucher and entry instructions checked
Seller contact and a copy of the terms saved
en.note: Unchecked items need your attention. A checked box records your review; it does not verify a supplier’s promise.
en.none: Nothing is saved automatically. Saving adds these notes to your account trip without replacing your existing plan.
en.signin: Sign in to save these notes. Download a copy first; signing in reloads this page.
en.saved: Checklist added to your account trip.
en.failed: Could not save. Your entries remain here; download a copy and try again.
en.invalid: Enter valid, non-negative amounts or leave both price fields blank.
en.partial: Complete both price fields, or clear both to save without a price estimate.
en.backup: Your browser downloads folder will contain the checklist. Keep it with your booking confirmation.
en.helpTitle: The right help, without the guessing.
en.helpIntro: Choose who you booked with first. That gets your question to the team that can actually act on it.
en.ours: DIY Travel Japan / Tokyo Stays KK
en.oursBody: For planning help, account questions, editorial corrections or a booking you arranged directly with Tokyo Stays KK, contact our Tokyo team.
en.externalBody: Use the original seller’s booking details for changes, cancellation and refund status. We cannot access or modify another platform’s reservations.
prepareList: Booking provider and booking reference
Activity name, visit date and timezone
What happened and the resolution you’re requesting
Relevant policy or confirmation screenshots, with sensitive details hidden
en.privacy: Do not send card numbers, passwords, passport scans or API keys. This page does not submit a support ticket; email and phone links open your own apps.
en.refundBody: Ask the original seller to distinguish: request received, cancellation accepted, refund approved, and refund sent. Ask for the amount, currency, destination and expected arrival date. Those stages are different; only the seller/payment provider can confirm the status.
en.confirmationTitle: Payment is not the same as a usable ticket
en.confirmationBody: Check whether the booking is pending or confirmed, then find the actual voucher and entry instructions. If a deadline is approaching and confirmation is missing, contact the seller before buying again.
en.supportNote: Support response times are not yet published. A phone or email link is a contact route, not a promise of immediate service.
en.discoverBody: Compare the details before paying. Keep a clear path to help if plans change.

zh-Hans.supportNote: 目前尚未公布客服回复时限。电话与邮件提供联系渠道，不代表承诺即时服务。

id.headline: Pahami detail sebelum memutuskan.
id.intro: Simpan tanggal, biaya total, dan ketentuan pembatalan bersama. Ini daftar perencanaan Anda, bukan reservasi atau jaminan pengembalian dana.
id.empty: Isi kedua jumlah; masukkan 0 jika tidak ada biaya tambahan.
id.estimate: Hanya berdasarkan masukan Anda. Bukan harga langsung atau konversi mata uang. Konfirmasikan pajak dan biaya wajib dengan penjual.
id.deadline: Batas pembatalan dan zona waktu (salin ketentuan penjual)
id.refund: Metode dan waktu pengembalian dana (salin ketentuan penjual)
checks: Tanggal, waktu, zona waktu, dan jenis tiket diperiksa
Jumlah tamu, aturan usia, dan bahasa diperiksa
Harga total, isi paket, dan biaya tambahan diperiksa
Batas pembatalan, biaya, dan metode refund diperiksa
Konfirmasi, voucher, dan petunjuk masuk diperiksa
Kontak penjual dan salinan ketentuan disimpan

id.none: Tidak disimpan otomatis. Catatan ditambahkan ke rencana akun tanpa mengganti rencana yang ada.
id.signin: Masuk untuk menyimpan. Unduh salinan dahulu; login memuat ulang halaman.
id.failed: Gagal menyimpan. Isian tetap di sini; unduh salinan lalu coba lagi.

id.partial: Isi kedua kolom harga atau kosongkan keduanya untuk menyimpan tanpa perkiraan.
id.backup: Daftar ada di folder unduhan browser. Simpan bersama konfirmasi pemesanan.
id.helpIntro: Pilih tempat Anda memesan agar pertanyaan sampai ke tim yang dapat menanganinya.
id.ours: DIY Travel Japan / Tokyo Stays KK

id.externalBody: Gunakan detail pesanan penjual awal untuk perubahan, pembatalan, dan status refund. Kami tidak dapat mengakses atau mengubah reservasi platform lain.
prepareList: Platform dan nomor pemesanan

id.refundBody: Minta penjual membedakan permintaan diterima, pembatalan diterima, refund disetujui, dan refund dikirim. Tanyakan jumlah, mata uang, tujuan pembayaran, dan perkiraan tanggal tiba. Hanya penjual atau penyedia pembayaran dapat memastikan statusnya.
id.confirmationTitle: Pembayaran bukan berarti tiket siap digunakan

id.supportNote: Waktu respons belum dipublikasikan. Telepon dan email adalah jalur kontak, bukan janji layanan seketika.
id.discoverBody: Bandingkan detail sebelum membayar. Temukan bantuan jika rencana berubah.

fil.headline: Linawin muna bago magpasya.
fil.intro: Pagsamahin ang eksaktong petsa, kabuuang gastos, at tuntunin sa pagkansela. Personal na checklist ito, hindi reserbasyon o garantiya ng refund.
fil.base: Kabuuang presyo para sa buong grupo
fil.extras: Dagdag na bayad para sa buong grupo
fil.empty: Punan ang dalawang halaga; ilagay ang 0 kung walang dagdag na bayad.
fil.estimate: Batay lamang sa input mo. Walang live na presyo o currency conversion. Tiyakin sa seller ang buwis at kinakailangang bayad.
fil.deadline: Huling oras ng pagkansela at timezone (kopyahin ang tuntunin ng seller)
fil.refund: Paraan at tagal ng refund (kopyahin ang tuntunin ng seller)
checks: Nasuri ang petsa, oras, timezone, at uri ng tiket
Nasuri ang bilang, patakaran sa edad, at wika
Nasuri ang kabuuang presyo, kasama, at dagdag na bayad
Nasuri ang cancellation deadline, bayad, at refund
Nasuri ang confirmation, voucher, at tagubilin sa pagpasok
Na-save ang kontak ng seller at kopya ng mga kondisyon
fil.note: Suriin ang hindi pa nakacheck. Itinatala ng check ang pagsusuri mo; hindi nito pinatutunayan ang pangako ng provider.
fil.save: Idagdag ang tala sa account trip
fil.none: Walang awtomatikong sine-save. Idinadagdag ang tala sa account trip nang hindi pinapalitan ang kasalukuyang plano.
fil.signin: Mag-sign in upang mag-save. Mag-download muna; magre-reload ang pahina kapag nag-sign in.
fil.saved: Naidagdag ang checklist sa account trip.
fil.failed: Hindi na-save. Nandito pa ang input; mag-download ng kopya at subukan muli.
fil.invalid: Maglagay ng wastong halagang hindi negatibo o iwang blangko ang parehong presyo.
fil.partial: Punan ang parehong presyo o burahin ang dalawa upang mag-save nang walang tantiya.
fil.backup: Nasa downloads folder ng browser ang checklist. Itabi kasama ng booking confirmation.
fil.helpIntro: Piliin muna kung saan ka nag-book upang makarating ang tanong sa tamang team.
fil.ours: DIY Travel Japan / Tokyo Stays KK
fil.oursBody: Para sa tulong sa plano, account, pagwawasto, o booking na direktang inayos sa Tokyo Stays KK, kontakin ang team namin sa Tokyo.
fil.externalBody: Gamitin ang detalye ng booking sa orihinal na seller para sa pagbabago, pagkansela, at refund. Hindi namin maa-access o mababago ang reserbasyon sa ibang platform.
prepareList: Booking platform at reference number
Pangalan ng aktibidad, petsa, at timezone
Ano ang nangyari at anong resolusyon ang hinihiling
Screenshot ng kondisyon o confirmation na natakpan ang sensitibong detalye
fil.privacy: Huwag magpadala ng card number, password, pasaporte, o API key. Hindi nagsusumite ng support ticket ang pahinang ito; binubuksan ng email at telepono ang sarili mong app.
fil.refundBody: Hilinging linawin ng seller kung natanggap ang request, tinanggap ang pagkansela, inaprubahan ang refund, o naipadala na ang refund. Itanong ang halaga, currency, pupuntahan, at inaasahang petsa. Seller o payment provider lamang ang makapagpapatunay ng status.
fil.confirmationTitle: Ang bayad ay hindi katumbas ng magagamit na tiket
fil.confirmationBody: Tingnan kung pending o confirmed ang booking, saka hanapin ang voucher at tagubilin sa pagpasok. Kung malapit na ang deadline at walang confirmation, kontakin muna ang seller bago bumili ulit.
fil.supportNote: Wala pang inilathalang oras ng pagsagot. Paraan ng pakikipag-ugnayan ang telepono at email, hindi pangako ng agarang serbisyo.
fil.discoverBody: Ihambing ang detalye bago magbayad. Alamin kung saan hihingi ng tulong kapag nagbago ang plano.
